description: This file defines a repository class for managing notes stored locally in SharedPreferences in an Android application. It provides methods to add, retrieve, update, and delete notes, handling JSON serialization/deserialization of note objects.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: A Kotlin class that manages notes stored in SharedPreferences as a JSON array, providing CRUD operations.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes, sorted by update time descending.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its unique ID.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with provided title and content, assigns current timestamp.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note by matching its ID and replacing its data.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Removes a note with the specified ID.

methods.name: loadJsonArray
methods.description: Loads the notes stored in SharedPreferences as a JSONArray.

methods.name: saveJsonArray
methods.description: Saves the provided JSONArray to SharedPreferences.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes a Note object into a JSONObject.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSONObject into a Note object if possible.
